item.title: An Open Letter to President Zelenskyy: Leave X
item.description:
Dear President Zelenskyy,

First of all, I want to express my deepest sympathy for the suffering of the Ukrainian people under Russia’s aggression, and my profound respect for your courage and leadership.

Your resistance, together with the extraordinary determination of the Ukrainian people, has helped prevent a Russian victory that would have made Europe far more unstable and dangerous. Your ability to mobilize international support has been remarkable. Ukraine deserves all the support it needs to resist Putin’s aggression and secure a just and lasting peace.
